title: Digital Platform and Website Executive
description:
Digital Platform and Website Executive (2687)
- Location:Oxford UK/ (with the ability to work from home under Oxfam GB's hybrid working arrangements)
- Workplace Type:Hybrid
- Hours:36 hours per week
- Salary:£28,057 with a discretionary range up to £30,761 depending on experience
- Job Family:Communications
- Division:CEO Office
- Grade:D
- Job Type:Open ended
- Closing Date:22 November 2026
- Country:United Kingdom

Oxfam is a global movement of people working together to end the injustice of poverty.

About the Role:

As part of an established team of digital experts, you'll play a key role in triaging and actioning website content update requests and digital platform management requests, whilst liaising with teams across Oxfam GB. You'll also support quality assurance activities and help ensure our digital platforms run smoothly and deliver a positive user experience.

This is a great role for someone at any stage of their career who likes variety, can work autonomously and wants to grow their digital expertise.

Because the website is on a content management system (CMS), this role does not require any coding experience.

Location: Oxford-based (Hybrid with up to 2 team days in the Oxford office per month required)

If you have any questions about the role, we'd love to hear from you.Please e-mail us at , making sure you include the job title and reference number of the role you're asking about.Please be aware we are unable to accept CVs or applications via e-mail.To apply, please use the "apply now" button on the right hand side of this advertisement

Your Cover Letter:

We are looking to interview people who share our values. Therefore, we ask applicants to write a covering letter answering these questions:
- How have you actively challenged your own unconscious biases and have worked to correct inequalities in the workplace?
- How do you support people's freedom to express ideas and opinions while also making sure no one faces discrimination?

If you find these questions hard to answer, think about what these points mean to you and share your thoughts and how they reflect your personal values.

Key Responsibilities:
- Triaging and actioning day-to-day website content updates.
- Edit, format, and publish web pages, blogs and media using our content management system (CMS).
- Administer digital platforms: support user permissions, cloud services, identify and fix broken links, test functionality and report technical issues.

We're looking for someone who has:
- Familiarity with CMS platforms and web design principles.
- Strong communication and organisational skills, with excellent attention to detail.
- A commitment to Oxfam's values, feminist principles and safeguarding requirements.

It would be a bonus if you also have familiarity with:
- AI and other technologies to improve processes and save time.
- Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG)
- Project management and work tracking software, i.e. Jira, Trello or Monday.
- User Experience (UX) design methodologies.

We offer:

We offer a competitive salary and a range of additional benefits to staff including flexible working options, generous pension scheme, annual leave, additional leave allowances, company sick pay, life assurance and a range of other benefits.

From the day you join Oxfam we invite you to stretch and learn in your role. Our wide range of Learning & Development opportunities includes in-house courses, e-learning modules, on-the job learning opportunities, coaching and mentoring, and much more.

You can read more about all Oxfam has to offer

How to apply:

As part of your online application, please upload your up to date CV and Cover Letter (see format above) explaining your suitability against the essential criteria in the job profile.

Our values and commitment to safeguarding

Oxfam is committed to preventing any type of unwanted behaviour at work including sexual harassment, exploitation and abuse, lack of integrity and financial misconduct; and committed to promoting the welfare of children, young people, adults and beneficiaries with whom Oxfam GB engages. Oxfam expects all staff and volunteers to share this commitment through our code of conduct. We place a high priority on ensuring that only those who share and demonstrate our are recruited to work for us.

The post holder will undertake the appropriate level of training and is responsible for ensuring that they understand and work within the safeguarding policies of the organisation.

All offers of employment will be subject to satisfactory references and appropriate screening checks, which can include criminal records and terrorism finance checks. Oxfam GB also participates in the .In line with this Scheme, we will request information from job applicants' previous employers about any findings of sexual exploitation, sexual abuse and/or sexual harassment during employment, or incidents under investigation when the applicant left employment. By submitting an application, the job applicant confirms his/her understanding of these recruitment procedures.

We are committed to ensuring diversity and gender equality within our organisation and encourage applicants from diverse backgrounds to apply.

About us

Oxfam is a global community who believe poverty isn't inevitable. It's an injustice that can be overcome. We are shop volunteers, women's right activists, marathon runners, aid workers, coffee farmers, street fundraisers, goat herders, policy experts, campaigners, water engineers and more. And we won't stop until everyone can live life without poverty for good.

is a member of of 21 organisations working together with partners and local communities in the areas of humanitarian, development and campaigning, in more than 90 countries.

A thriving diverse Oxfam:

It's people power that brings about change. To play our part as a global organisation working to overcome poverty and inequality, we need equality, diversity and inclusion across our community of staff, partners and volunteers. Together, we're committed to becoming a more diverse workforce, better able to tackle the global challenges that face our world today.

To do that:
- We need to dismantle the unequal power structures that exist everywhere, this including Oxfam and the wider development and charity sectors.
- We need an inclusive Oxfam where everyone can bring who they are to our work and feels celebrated for the differences they bring.
- We want and need everyone, and that means we need you.

title: Paralegal - Commercial & Residential Property
description:
Property Paralegal Oxfordshire

Salary: £28,000 - £30,000

Location: Oxford

Looking for an opportunity where you can develop your experience, work on quality matters and learn from experienced lawyers?

A highly regarded law firm in Oxfordshire is looking to strengthen its Property team with the addition of a Property Paralegal.

This is a great opportunity to join an established team advising a varied client base, including individuals, business owners, entrepreneurs and high-net-worth clients. The firm takes a personal, relationship-led approach, with a focus on delivering quality work rather than operating in a high-volume environment.

The role

You'll work closely with experienced Property lawyers, supporting a varied caseload of residential and commercial property matters. The role offers exposure to bespoke transactions and the opportunity to build your technical knowledge while taking an active role in the progression of matters.

Your work will include:
- Supporting residential and commercial property transactions.
- Assisting with acquisitions, disposals and property investment matters.
- Working on landlord and tenant matters, including leases and lease extensions.
- Drafting legal documents and correspondence.
- Liaising with clients, solicitors and other third parties.
- Undertaking legal research and assisting with more complex matters.
- Supporting the wider team with transaction progression and file management.

What they're looking for

The firm is open to hearing from Property Paralegals, Legal Assistants and experienced Conveyancing professionals looking for a new challenge.

You'll ideally have some previous property experience, a strong eye for detail and a genuine interest in developing your career within the sector. Just as importantly, you'll be organised, client-focused and keen to learn within a close-knit team.

Why consider it?
- Quality over quantity: Work on bespoke matters rather than a high-volume, repetitive caseload.
- Varied exposure: Develop experience across residential and commercial property work.
- Experienced colleagues: Learn directly from established Property lawyers.
- Interesting clients: Support matters for individuals, business owners and HNW clients.
- Career development: Build a strong foundation for your longer-term career in Property.

If you're looking for a role where you can broaden your experience and develop within a quality-focused team, I'd be happy to have a confidential conversation.

Get in touch to find out more.

title: Procurement Assistant
company: City Site Solutions Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
We are working with a well-established, family-run main contractor based in Oxfordshire, specialising in high-end residential new-build and refurbishment projects for private clients. Due to continued business growth, they are looking to recruit a Procurement Assistant to join their team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a background in procurement or purchasing who understands that, within high-end residential construction, sourcing the right materials is about more than just price. You will play an important role in sourcing quality products, bespoke finishes and specialist materials that meet the expectations of discerning private clients.

Working closely with the company directors on a daily basis, you will gain valuable insight into the business and its projects, with the opportunity to develop your skills and progress as the company continues to grow.

Key Responsibilities:
- Sourcing and purchasing materials for high-end residential new-build and refurbishment projects.
- Identifying suitable suppliers and obtaining competitive quotations.
- Sourcing bespoke materials, specialist products and high-quality finishes to meet project specifications.
- Liaising with suppliers, subcontractors, site teams and company directors.
- Monitoring orders, deliveries and lead times to ensure materials arrive when required.
- Maintaining strong supplier relationships and identifying opportunities to improve value without compromising quality.
- Supporting the wider team with day-to-day procurement and purchasing activities.

The Ideal Candidate:
- Previous experience in procurement, purchasing or materials sourcing, ideally within construction.
- An understanding of construction materials, finishes and supplier markets.
- An appreciation for quality, attention to detail and the importance of bespoke specifications within high-end residential projects.
- Strong communication, organisation and negotiation skills.
- A proactive approach, with the confidence to liaise directly with company directors and suppliers.
- A desire to learn, develop and build a long-term career within a growing business.

What's on Offer?
- The opportunity to join a respected, family-run construction business.
- Exposure to prestigious, high-end residential projects across Oxfordshire.
- Direct daily contact with company directors and decision-makers.
- Genuine opportunities for career development and progression as the business grows.
- A varied role where quality, craftsmanship and attention to detail are valued.

If you have procurement or purchasing experience and are looking for an opportunity to develop your career within the high-end residential construction sector, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today to find out more.

title: Quality Control Administrator
description:
Quality Control Administrator

Location: Oxfordshire
Rate: £20.00 per hour Umbrella
Contract: Ongoing
Hours: Full-time

Morson are recruiting on behalf of a leading Formula 1 team based in Oxfordshire for a Quality Control Administrator to provide administrative support to their Quality Control function.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a fast-paced motorsport manufacturing environment, supporting inspection activities, maintaining accurate quality records and ensuring components move efficiently through the production process.

Key Responsibilities
- Provide administrative support to the Quality Control and Inspection team.
- Monitor and manage inspection queues, ensuring components are prioritised in line with production requirements.
- Liaise with Production, Planning, Manufacturing and Stores to coordinate and expedite urgent requirements.
- Process inspected components accurately through the business ERP system and release them to the next stage of production.
- Chase outstanding components and monitor their progress through Quality Control.
- Track and follow up on Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), ensuring actions are completed promptly.
- Maintain accurate quality, inspection and production records, including electronic and hard-copy documentation.
- Prepare and distribute reports relating to inspection activity and production progress.
- Work closely with internal departments to resolve delays and maintain production workflow.

Skills & Experience
- Previous experience in an administrative or coordination role within an engineering or manufacturing environment.
- Engineering background with the ability to read and interpret engineering drawings.
- Understanding of technical specifications and manufacturing processes.
- Experience using ERP/MRP systems, ideally Microsoft Dynamics 365.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word and Outlook.
- Strong organisational and administrative skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
- Good communication skills, with the confidence to liaise across different departments.
- A proactive approach with the ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

Apply Now

If you have experience in engineering or manufacturing administration and are looking for an opportunity to work within a leading Formula 1 team, Morson would like to hear from you.

title: Receptionist/Front of House Co-ordinator
description:
Receptionist/Front of House Co-ordinator

Reporting to: London Office Manager

Office size: Approximately 120 employees

Salary: 30-35k

Role Type: Permanent, Full time, 8:00-5:30

Location: Oxford Street, Full time in the office

Key Responsibilities
- Welcome clients and visitors to the office and promptly notify employees when their guests have arrived.
- Manage the main company telephone lines, directing calls to the relevant person or team and taking and forwarding accurate messages where required.
- Monitor the general enquiries inboxes across the company, ensuring enquiries are promptly forwarded to the appropriate person or team.
- Take ownership of all incoming and outgoing post, including sorting, distributing and arranging couriers and special deliveries.
- Receive parcels and deliveries and ensure they reach the correct recipient.
- Maintain a tidy, welcoming and professional reception and front-of-house area.
- Liaise with the building reception, security, facilities and management teams where required.
- Assist with visitor and employee access, including access cards where applicable.
- Provide support to the wider office admin team where required, including assisting with meeting set-up, office events and other general office-related tasks.
- Assist with new starters, office events, supplies and other day-to-day office requirements.
- Act as an approachable first point of contact for general office queries.

Personal Profile
- Friendly, confident and professional with a welcoming manner.
- An excellent communicator with a strong telephone manner.
- Highly organised with good attention to detail.
- Proactive and comfortable taking ownership of tasks.
- Able to manage calls, emails, visitors and other requests efficiently.
- Confident dealing with clients, employees, suppliers and contractors.
- Comfortable using Microsoft Outlook, Teams and other Microsoft 365 applications.
- Discreet and professional when handling confidential calls, correspondence and visitors.
